thread:
Ana: FYI Novus Health flagged by budget-sentinel at 03:06 UTC. Large embedding ingestion during onboarding blew past their daily threshold. Need quick QBR-ready notes and a mitigation plan. :rotating_light:
Mike: saw it. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/clients/novus/spend shows a spike from the embedding route. Current daily tokens ~1.5M, projected monthly ~45M if this continues.
Lena: They ran a full export of historical records without dedupe/chunking. I left a note on the CS ticket but let's offer a short remediation playbook.
Rahil: quick triage checklist I recommend:
- pause ingestion jobs older than 90 days
- run a lightweight dedupe pass (hash-based)
- enable batching (batch_size: 128) for embedding calls
- switch to convo-level caching where applicable
Mike: OpsBot alert dump: OpsBot: [budget-sentinel] Account NOVUS-453 over threshold. Trigger: embed-ingest. Tokens today: 1,512,342. Action flagged: temp-throttle available; notify FinOps for QBR projection.
Ana: For the QBR we need 3 projection scenarios by COB tomorrow:
1) Mitigated: apply dedupe + batching + throttle -> projected monthly tokens and $ impact
2) Partial: batching + quantization on non-prod models -> medium reduction
3) Baseline: no changes -> status quo projection
Lena: I'll book a 30m implementation session with their engineering lead for tomorrow 10:30 PT. Will prepare a 1-pager with steps and a short demo of Redwood Optimize presets.
Rahil: SQL I use to break down routes for cost slides:
```
SELECT route, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id='NOVUS-453' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Mike: I'll assemble the three slide variants (tokens + cost + recommended actions) and add a simple sensitivity table (adoption rate 25/50/100%). Also adding a one-line QBR takeaway: "Ingestion-driven embedding surge; proposed optimizations can reduce monthly token spend by ~35-65% depending on adoption."
Ana: Can FinOps run the dollar conversion for those scenarios and add a per-seat impact line for their renewal packet?
Mike: tagging @Rahil for the FinOps numbers.
Rahil: will run cost conversion and include a conservative ARR impact row. Expect numbers by EOD tomorrow.
OpsBot: [action] budget_rule/novus-temp-throttle-180999 created by Mike: pause ingestion when daily tokens > 2,000,000; severity=moderate; notify=@customer-success.
Lena: I'll send Novus the recommended email and include a checkbox for immediate throttle acceptance. Draft:
"Hi Novus team — we noticed a high-volume ingestion run that is driving elevated token usage. We recommend a short joint session to implement batching, dedupe, and Optimize presets. We can also enable a temporary throttle until changes are live. Reply here if you'd like us to enable the throttle immediately.
Best, Lena (CS)"
Ana: Good. Please capture any doc gaps or friction points during the session. For the QBR renewal slide, annotate whether the customer accepts the throttle and whether they adopt Optimize presets within 7 days. That will influence the renewal risk color (green/amber/red).
Mike: done — will add a renewal risk note and slide comment.
Rahil: also adding an ask for engineering to add a pre-ingest size estimate in their pipeline so we can alert earlier for large imports. I'll include in the action items.
Ana: thanks all. Keep thread updated with session notes and customer acceptance. I'll compile feedback snippets for the QBR "customer feedback" box. :thumbsup:
